text: egui/eframe 0.37 in crates/acre-gui differs from 0.29-0.31. eframe::App needs fn ui(&mut self, ui, frame) and has an optional logic(ctx, frame). Panel::top/bottom/left(id).show(ui, ..) replaces TopBottomPanel and SidePanel, MenuBar::new().ui replaces menu::bar, ui.close() replaces close_menu, and Id::new is deprecated for Id::unique. On Wayland eframe calls ui only after a compositor frame callback and runs logic alone until one comes (src/native/run.rs, MISSED_REDRAW_TIMEOUT).
